title: District Watch
body:
# District Watch

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/district-watch-heading-scaled.png)

# This is **District Watch**, our project to expose the worst school board members and school leaders **focused on indoctrinating children rather than educating them.** We’re naming names because we believe in **restoring America’s schools** - not surrendering them.

# **But we need your help.**

Whether it’s dropping a **[tip](https://www.restoringedu.com/district-watch/got-a-tip/)** or [**funding our work**, ]( https://restorationaction.revv.co/donate-now)we can’t win the war alone. District Watch is a project of **[Restoration News](https://restoration-news.com)**, your source for exclusive, headline-smashing news and opinion.

# Click on your state to see the WORST school board members and superintendents.
